info.title: OpenReloading API
info.description: Records of cartridges, components and competitions, and the exterior and interior ballistics models. Quantities are SI (m, kg, s, Pa, K, rad) unless a field names another unit. Results are simulations, not load data.

tags.description: Cartridges with their C.I.P. sheet values, manufacturers, powders and bullets.

tags.name: Exterior
tags.description: Trajectories, truing to observed drops or velocities, range strings and gyroscopic stability.

tags.name: Interior
tags.description: Simulations of the shot inside the barrel and the charge that reaches a target. Results are simulations, not load data.

Answers each parameter with its identifiability status, value and confidence interval, the residuals with their chi-square test and the condition of the fit.

post.description: Runs the M3 lumped-parameter model of the shot from ignition to muzzle exit and answers the time curves of pressure, travel, velocity and burnt fraction, the peak pressure, muzzle velocity and energy, the pressure range from the tolerances, and warnings. A `ladder` runs one step per charge. A `cartridge` id adds its CIP Pmax limits. Results are simulations, not load data.
